sloka: रामः अपि रात्रि शेषेण तेन एव महद् अन्तरम् ।जगाम पुरुष व्याघ्रः पितुर् आज्ञाम् अनुस्मरन् ॥२-४९-१॥
transliteration: rāmaḥ api rātri śeṣeṇa tena eva mahad antaram ।jagāma puruṣa vyāghraḥ pitur ājñām anusmaran ॥2-49-1॥

translations.english: Recollecting his father's command, Rama, the foremost among men, covered a long distance during the remaining part of the night.
